description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for customer search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties for filtering by customer name and customer IDs, with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CustomerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to encapsulate customer search filtering criteria, including customer name and customer IDs, with a default sort field set to 'customer.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter parameters with the default sort field 'customer.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current customer name filter value, or null if not set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the customer name filter value.

methods.name: getCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns the list of customer IDs filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setCustomerIds
methods.description: Sets the list of customer IDs filter.
